people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.
translations.bsb: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come.
translations.kjv: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
translations.asv: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Jehovah throughout your generations.
